details.request: As per given reference mockup the design is not proper so can you recheck and fix it.
details.method: Did not guess -- re-served the reference HTML and used javascript_tool to pull exact getComputedStyle() values (fonts, colors, gradients, border-radius, image treatment) from the live reference DOM, then compared numerically against the build rather than eyeballing screenshots.
issues_found_and_fixed: Header background was the scaffold default white (#fff) -- reference uses translucent navy (rgba(21,25,73,0.85)) with backdrop-blur so it blends into the dark hero instead of showing a white seam. Fixed globally in app.css .header (affects every page).

Hero background was an oversimplified 2-stop radial-gradient -- reference is a 3-layer gradient (purple glow top-right + teal glow bottom-left over a navy base). Replaced with the exact verified gradient.
Hero was text-only, no photo -- reference is a two-column layout with a 543x680-ish photo, 28px rounded corners, gradient scrim. Added app/routes/_index.jsx hero-photo column + CSS.
Body copy font was never set -- reference uses Manrope; only Halogen (headings) had been wired up. Added Google Fonts link in root.jsx links().

Manrope silently failed to load even after adding the link -- ROOT CAUSE: Hydrogen's default Content-Security-Policy (entry.server.jsx, createContentSecurityPolicy) does not allow fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com by default, so the browser blocked it with no visible console error (checked network requests, found zero google fonts requests, then found the CSP mechanism). Fixed by adding styleSrc/fontSrc overrides in entry.server.jsx. Re-verified via document.fonts -- Manrope now genuinely shows status "loaded".
CTA buttons had border-radius 4px -- reference measured 999px (full pill). Fixed globally (.hero-cta and inherited by collection page CTAs).
H1 was capped at a max of 72px (4.5rem) -- reference measured 96px desktop. Raised the clamp ceiling to 6rem (96px).
details.not_fixed_yet: hero_image Metaobject field left unset -- Admin API token lacks write_files scope, upload script written and ready (scripts/upload-hero-image.mjs) but blocked on a scope grant, tracked as risks[R8]. Static asset fallback used in the meantime, clearly commented in code as temporary.
details.verification: Rebuilt clean (exit 0) after each fix, re-served both the reference and the build side by side, pulled getComputedStyle() from both and compared numerically (not just visual screenshots) for font-family, font-size, background gradients, border-radius, and confirmed via document.fonts that Manrope actually loads post-fix.

details.page_wide_bug_found_and_fixed: body had no explicit background/color/color-scheme set. On a browser with a dark color-scheme preference, this made several sections' dark-on-transparent text (e.g. brand-section feature list) render as dark text on a black canvas -- unreadable. Fixed by setting body background/color/color-scheme:light explicitly. This was a real, previously-unnoticed accessibility bug, not just a mockup-fidelity issue -- would have affected every page, every viewer with OS/browser dark mode on.
details.verification_method: Real browser, not assumption. Hit a genuine tool quirk: screenshots consistently failed/returned stale frames after a scroll action specifically (confirmed via computed getBoundingClientRect/backgroundColor checks showing correct values while screenshots stayed black) -- worked around by resizing the viewport taller instead of scrolling, which captures cleanly. Verified full homepage (all 8 sections + footer), full collection page (grid + all 5 lower sections + footer), and confirmed no PDP regression from the color-scheme fix.
